definition: An occurring intense suffering preventable by a qualifying being with no blocking cost recognized by the fixed investigator. Recognition is a separate relation; no closure from unrecognized to nonexistent is imposed. This intentionally limited projection omits profusion, background evidence and epistemic warrant.
note: Modeling stipulation prompted by Rowe p.337’s explicit separation of appearance from actuality; it tests logical sufficiency only. A theory of rational warrant and total evidence would be needed to source a stronger epistemic or probability claim.
